# `oaap help`

list the commands, or write the CLI reference as Markdown (RFC-0078 stage 0).

**Root:** runs without `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap help [--markdown DIR]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--markdown DIR` | write one Markdown file per command into DIR (with front matter) instead of printing the list |

Generated from the parser of reference 0.1.254. Examples and the reasons behind a command: [hand-written CLI reference](../README.md).
